request.text: I'm heading to the farmers' market after lunch. Check whether it will rain in Portland this afternoon, and remind me at 12:30 PM to put the reusable bags in the car.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up whether rain is expected in Portland this afternoon for the user's farmers' market trip.
Create a 12:30 PM reminder to put the reusable bags in the car.

new_goals.description: Determine whether rain is expected in Portland this afternoon for the farmers' market trip.
new_goals.source_text: Check whether it will rain in Portland this afternoon.
success_criteria: Obtain the forecast for Portland this afternoon.
Report the rain outlook without inventing forecast details.

new_goals.description: Create a reminder to put the reusable bags in the car before the market trip.
new_goals.source_text: Remind me at 12:30 PM to put the reusable bags in the car.

constraints.reminder_content: put the reusable bags in the car

success_criteria: Create one reminder for 12:30 PM with the requested bag-loading instruction.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The turn establishes two independent new Goals: obtain trip-relevant weather information and create a timed reminder.

semantic_facts: The Plan must cover both canonical Goals rather than treating the reminder as part of the weather lookup.
The weather lookup must preserve Portland and this afternoon, while the reminder must preserve 12:30 PM and the reusable-bag instruction.
The two Capability activities are independent and may be scheduled without an invented dependency.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims a particular forecast before the weather lookup returns.
The assistant claims the bags were placed in the car or the market errand was completed.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Independent information and reminder Goals are collapsed into one incomplete Goal.
Arguments from one Goal leak into the other Capability activity or an unnecessary ordering dependency is invented.
